newsItems.title: How OpenAI’s human mistake led to the AI-powered hack on Hugging Face
newsItems.summary: OpenAI made a mistake setting up what it called a “highly isolated” testing environment and sandbox. According to cybersecurity experts, that human mistake is what made the AI-powered attack on Hugging Face possible.
newsItems.whyItMatters: 基础模型能力、价格和开放策略的变化，会迅速传导到整个应用生态。
newsItems.titleZh: OpenAI 的人为错误如何导致 Hugging Face 上的 AI 攻击
newsItems.summaryZh: OpenAI 在设置所谓的“高度隔离”测试环境和沙箱时犯了一个错误。网络安全专家表示，正是这种人为错误使得对 Hugging Face 的人工智能攻击成为可能。
